Name: Morning Dew Mod Manager
Author: NesrynRoseAstra
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Morning Dew[/b][/size]
[size=4]The friendly mod manager for Stardew Valley[/size][/center]

[b]Morning Dew[/b] is a small, fast Windows app that makes managing SMAPI mods easy, even if you have never touched a mod folder before. Tick a box to turn a mod on or off, press [b]Play[/b], and see in plain English whether anything is wrong. No file editing, no guessing.

[size=5][b]What it does[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Play button[/b]: starts Stardew Valley through SMAPI with the mods you have turned on. It warns you first if something will stop a mod from loading.[/*]
[*][b]One-click on/off[/b]: tick a mod to turn it on, untick to turn it off. Nothing is deleted. (It simply adds or removes a dot at the start of the mod's folder name, which is how SMAPI skips a mod.)[/*]
[*][b]Status at a glance[/b]: a big card tells you "All good, ready to play" or exactly what needs fixing.[/*]
[*][b]Conflict finder[/b]: finds duplicate mods (SMAPI loads none of the copies), missing or turned-off requirements, mods SMAPI will skip, and Content Patcher packs that change the same thing. Each problem comes with plain advice and a one-click action where possible.[/*]
[*][b]Clickable folders[/b]: every duplicate or problem shows its folder as a link that opens File Explorer right on it.[/*]
[*][b]Game log reader[/b]: reads SMAPI's last log and explains it: which mods were skipped and why, what each error means, and what to do. Repeated errors are grouped, and there is a Copy summary button for asking for help.[/*]
[*][b]Update list[/b]: a sortable table of every mod with installed version, latest version and status. Works straight away from SMAPI's own report in your last log; an optional "Check online" button (only runs when you press it) refreshes it from smapi.io, and with your own Nexus key also looks at Nexus pages.[/*]
[*][b]Mod sets[/b]: save which mods are on and switch between sets, for example "Vanilla+" and "Co-op".[/*]
[*][b]Tidy up[/b]: finds duplicate mods, leftover zip files and empty folders. Removed items are moved aside and can be put back.[/*]
[*][b]Right-click a mod[/b]: turn on/off, open its folder, open its Nexus page, or delete it. Deleting sends the whole mod folder to the Windows Recycle Bin so you can restore it.[/*]
[*][b]Click a mod to learn about it[/b]: what it does, what it needs, and which other mods need it.[/*]
[*][b]Filters and search[/b]: All, On, Off, or Needs attention, plus search by name or author.[/*]
[*][b]Themes[/b]: Dark, Light, a pink/blue/lilac [b]Pastel[/b] theme and a [b]Halloween[/b] theme, both with gentle animation.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley with [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] installed[/*]
[*]Nothing else to install. The app is a single exe.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Download the file and extract it anywhere you like (your Desktop is fine).[/*]
[*]Run [b]MorningDew.exe[/b]. It finds your Stardew Valley Mods folder automatically. If it can't, it asks you to pick the "Mods" folder once.[/*]
[*]Close the game before turning mods on or off.[/*]
[/list][b]Windows may show a "Windows protected your PC" (SmartScreen) message[/b] because the app is new and not code-signed. Choose [b]More info[/b], then [b]Run anyway[/b].

[size=5][b]Good to know[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Morning Dew changes mod folders only in the ways described above. It does not edit mods' files, and it does not add or change anything inside the game itself.[/*]
[*]Nothing is sent over the internet unless you press "Check online" and agree. Then only your enabled mods' IDs and versions go to smapi.io (and to Nexus Mods if you add your own key). Your key stays on your PC.[/*]
[*]The conflict finder reads Content Patcher files without evaluating conditions, so overlaps are heads-ups to review, not proof that something is broken.[/*]
[*]Settings, mod sets and theme are stored in %APPDATA%\MorningDew.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Uninstalling[/b][/size]
Delete MorningDew.exe (and, if you want, the %APPDATA%\MorningDew folder). Your mods are untouched. If you left any mod turned off, remove the dot at the start of its folder name or turn it on in Morning Dew first.

[size=5][b]Feedback[/b][/size]
Found a bug or want a feature? Leave a comment or post a bug report. If something looks wrong, the Game log button's "Copy summary" text helps a lot.

[i]Morning Dew is an unofficial fan-made tool and is not affiliated with or endorsed by ConcernedApe, Chucklefish, or the SMAPI team.[/i]
